coreMemory.chinese: 杀死；使死亡；终止；扼杀；消磨时间
coreMemory.english: v. to cause a person, animal, or plant to die；v. to stop an activity, process, or idea completely；v. to spend time doing something while waiting
coreMemory.structure: kill time /ˈkɪl ˈtaɪm/（消磨时间）；kill an idea /ˈkɪl ˈæn aɪˈdiːə/（扼杀想法）；kill the mood /ˈkɪl ðə ˈmuːd/（破坏气氛）；kill a process /ˈkɪl ə ˈprɑˌsɛs/（终止进程）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ be killed at an accident → ✅ be killed in an accident；❌ kill two birds at one stone → ✅ kill two birds with one stone

commonErrors.note: 在“be killed in an accident”所表达的这个具体含义中，要用介词 in；换成 at 会破坏这个固定结构或改变原意。

commonErrors.wrong: kill two birds at one stone
commonErrors.right: kill two birds with one stone
commonErrors.note: 在“kill two birds with one stone”所表达的这个具体含义中，要用介词 with；换成 at 会破坏这个固定结构或改变原意。

coreMemory.example: I read short articles to kill time on the train.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 我在火车上读短文消磨时间。

meanings.english: to cause a person, animal, or plant to die
meanings.example: The disease can kill young plants quickly.
meanings.translation: 这种病会很快使幼苗死亡。

meanings.english: to stop an activity, process, or idea completely
meanings.example: Do not kill the process while it is saving your work.
meanings.translation: 保存工作时不要终止进程。

meanings.english: to spend time doing something while waiting
meanings.example: I read short articles to kill time on the train.
meanings.translation: 我在火车上读短文消磨时间。

items.phrase: kill two birds with one stone

fixedPhrases.example: I read short articles to kill time on the train.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我在火车上读短文消磨时间。

fixedPhrases.example: Harsh criticism can kill a good idea too early.
fixedPhrases.translation: 严厉批评可能过早扼杀好想法。

fixedPhrases.example: A loud alarm can kill the mood in a quiet room.
fixedPhrases.translation: 响亮的闹铃会破坏安静房间的气氛。

fixedPhrases.example: Do not kill the process while it is saving your work.
fixedPhrases.translation: 保存工作时不要终止进程。

fixedPhrases.example: Many people are killed in road accidents each year.
fixedPhrases.translation: 每年有许多人死于道路事故。

fixedPhrases.phrase: kill two birds with one stone
fixedPhrases.example: Walking to the store can kill two birds with one stone: exercise and shopping.
fixedPhrases.translation: 步行去商店能一举两得：锻炼和购物。

synonyms.difference: destroy 更侧重“毁坏；消灭”；kill 的核心义是“杀死”。两者意思接近，但替换时仍要核对宾语、介词和具体语境。

antonyms.usage: 当 kill 表示“杀死”时，save 表示“挽救；保全”。两者只在这个明确义项下构成直接对比，其他用法不能一概互换。

derivatives.note: 可作名词，也可非正式地表示极难或极强。

relatedVocabulary.category: 语义关联：一起理解更清楚
